Container.Name: QuietHarvest
Container.Overview:
QuietHarvest is a self-hosted, human-paced content harvester (RSS to start). It collects one item per cadence tick rather than hammering a source.
This template runs the app only. QuietHarvest needs a PostgreSQL database: install a PostgreSQL container from Community Applications (or use an existing one), create a database/user, and fill in the Postgres* fields below. The app resolves aria2/ffmpeg/yt-dlp internally and runs as PUID:PGID so files in your Downloads share are owned correctly.
See docs/deployment.md in the project for the full guide.
Container.Description: Self-hosted, human-paced content harvester. App-only template — bring your own PostgreSQL (install one from Community Applications and point the Postgres* fields at it).

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where collected files are saved. Point new plots at /downloads.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Cursors and aria2 resume sessions (small, persistent).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID owning files on your shares (Unraid default 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID owning files on your shares (Unraid default 100).

Config.Name: Default download path
Config.Description: Pre-fills the New Plot download path.

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP of your PostgreSQL container.
